description: Main editor sidebar shell rendering the space switcher, a search and new-page header, Favorites, Recent, the root page tree, and a trash toggle, plus a resize handle and template gallery. Loads its data through the context data provider.

parameters.name: ActivePageId
parameters.description: ID of the currently active (open) page — highlights it in the tree.

parameters.name: OnTrashRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests to open the full trash view.
